ONLY RELEVANT DOCUMENT(S) ARE TO BE UPLOADED FOR TECHNICAL AND COMMERCIAL SCRUTINY. SUBMISSION OF ADDITIONAL DOCUMENTS BEYOND THE REQUIREMENT, S HALL NOT BE TAKEN COGNIZANCE OF. 6) THE TAX INVOICE (S) SHOULD MANDATORILY CONTAIN THE GSTIN OF THE CONSIG NEE AND RSPBACK UP PO NUMBER FOR REFERENCE. 7) SUPPLIER SHALL ENSURE THAT THE INVOICE IS RAISED IN THE NAME OF CONSIGN EE WITH GSTIN OF CONSIGNEE ONLY. 8) BIDDER'S OFFER IS LIABLE TO BE REJECTED IF THEY DON'T UPLOAD ANY OF THE C ERTIFICATES/ DOCUMENTS SOUGHT IN THE BID DOCUMENT, ATC AND CORRIGENDU M IF ANY.
